tei:div.tei:p: lha sa'i bla rabs chos rgyud byon tshul bzhugs so/

oṃ swa ti/ lha sa'i thog ma/ snyos lo tstsha ba rin chen grags pas/ rgya gar du byon nas/ slob dpon chen po bya liṃ ta a tsarya la/ chos don thog tu dril la| kha zin che ba zhig zhu byas pas/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi skor gnang*/ las kha tshar tshang ba zhig zhu byas pas/ gshin rje dgra nag gnang*/ la chung zha ི ga gis tsa na dgra yod pas/ bka' bsrung zhig yang zhu byas pas/ 'jigs byed la bkrag bshad sbrel nas gnang*/ phag rgyud skor gsum zhes grags te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de'i sras slob dpon rdo rje bla ma/ pha rgyud skor gsum la mkhas zhing*/ bod kyi mi chen bzhir grags pa'i/ ya ba gcig yin/ de'i sras| dpal seng ge'i sras/ snyos nag grags pa dpal/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sku skyes yin par zhang rin po che'i lung bstan/ khong gis sras/ ras chen snyos lha nang ba de/ rgya gar gyi nag po spyod pa chung ba yin par zhang rin po che'i lung bstan 'dug cing*/ rtsa rir byon dus mkha' 'gro mas kyang lung bstan no| |zhang gi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ 'bri khung chos rje'i drung du/ na ro chos drug gsan | rtsa ri ti se sogs la byon/ sgrub pa nan tan che bar mdzad/ mon gyi pa gro lcal kha la sogs par/ tshogs pa yang thog re bskyangs/ byang du lha nang btab/ lha pa nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa yang de nas byung*/ khong gi dbon po/ lha rin chen rgyal de nyid/ lha sras mu ne btsan po'i sku skyes yin skad| skyor mo lung du rab byung mdzad/ pha rgyud skaur gsum la mkhas lcal kha sa g.yos kyi rgyel ba'i tshab/ phag ri rin chen sgang brtsigs/ lha nang du gdan sar bzhugs pas/ rgyal khrims che ba'i dmag sna'i gnod pa byung bas/ skyid smad du byon nas/ rab grong brtsigs lha nang du/ khu 'u'i bla ma grub thob 'dam seng gdan sa la brdzangs/ 'dam pa rigs pas nye gnas byas/ gye re dgon pa btab cing*/ gye re lha khang gi gtsug lag khang brtsigs/

de'i dbon rgyud/ bla ma dar ma rgyal po dang*/ de'i dbon po lha gzi brjid rgyal po chos kyi rgyud pa ni/ lha rin chen rgyal po khu dbon la/ mkhas pa dge brag pa tshul gzhon gyi thug de'i slob ma mkhas pa byang dar/ de'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs gzi rjid rgyal po la sogs/ lha rab bris pas lha mi kun/ kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog |dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/lha sa'i bla rabs chos rgyud byon tshul/ -PAGE 284--PAGE 283-
